doc: Hue / saturation / value (the v2 adjustment): a true HSV edit of the straight colour. V = max(R,G,B), S = (V - min) / V (0 when V = 0), H in degrees (grey: 0). H' = H + hue (positive = CSS hue-rotate direction, red -> green -> blue), S' = min(1, S * saturation), V' = V * value, back to RGB (HSV hexcone), each channel clamped to 0..1 (value > 1 saturates channels). Alpha unchanged.
